cut_rhythm.pattern: 10 scenes inside a screen-in-scene reel (only the inner edited video described; monitor and room ignored). Slow logo open (0.617s), then 3D cube field (1.95s), then a rapid-fire type burst of four scenes of 0.2s, 0.233s, 0.4s, 0.3s at 4.05-5.183s (NO / TIMELINE / KEYFRAMES / ONE PROMPT.), then a data card (1.75s), particle burst (1.784s) and a long closing hold (4.933s). Each scene carries a numbered HUD label 01-PROMPT .. 09-CLAUDE. Cuts follow the section changes, not the beat.

shots.camera_angle: flat 2D motion-graphics boards except scene 3 (low-angle perspective over a 3D cube field, tilted then settling) and scene 9 (radial particle tunnel into starburst); no filmed footage
shots.composition: centered hero element (asterisk, CLAUDE, NO, TIMELINE, KEYFRAMES, ONE PROMPT., clock digits, terminal window, logo); every scene framed by HUD: top-left 'CLAUDE CODE/ MOTION LAB', top-right 'OPUS 5.5' pill, bottom-left section label, bottom-right timecode, bottom progress line, corner brackets

elements.easing: title text builds letter by letter with a typed cursor (CLAUD_ at 0.5-0.8s of the screen clip) ; cube wave ripples outward from the asterisk and forms a stepped pyramid; strike-through bar sweeps across TIMELINE; digits roll then settle (6:33:33 -> 0:11:28 -> 0:09:41); bar and line chart grow; progress bar fills in terminal; 12 dots ring morphs into a 12-ray asterisk

text.role: kinetic title words (CLAUDE, NO, TIMELINE, KEYFRAMES, ONE PROMPT.) plus UI data card and terminal mock, small mono HUD labels, closing caption 'COMMENT "CLAUDE" FOR THE FU..' (cut off in the sampled frame)
text.weight: black condensed grotesque for key words, serif italic for 'now does moti..', monospace for HUD and terminal
text.case: UPPERCASE key words, lowercase italic subtitle
text.position: key words centered; HUD in the frame margins
text.size_class: key words very large (TIMELINE and KEYFRAMES span about 80 percent of frame width); HUD tiny
text.animation_in: hard snap for NO and KEYFRAMES, typed build for CLAUDE, strike-through sweep for TIMELINE, repeating outlined echo rows behind ONE PROMPT.

grade.look: Claude brand palette: warm grey-beige paper, near-black brown, and one hot orange (#EF5F2A class) with cream type; scenes alternate dark, orange, off-white and beige for rhythm

layout.safe_zones: inner video shown on a screen in a vertical reel; only inner video described
layout.framing_notes: crop 810x538 from tracked quad, tracked_fraction 1.0; left and right sliver of black bars at the crop sides (visible in all collages)

recipe.notes: Components: HUD frame with timecode and section label per scene, glowing asterisk logo, 3D voxel field (about 484 cubes, per the terminal mock), black/orange display type, strike-through bar, outlined echo text rows, data card (rolling clock 'EDIT TIME - ONE 15 s REEL', YOU vs CLAUDE bar, -98 percent pill, three stat tiles 9/200/33 then 9/214/38, reels per week line to 21 / wk), line-particle tunnel to starburst, terminal window with checklist and render bar, 12-dot ring morph to asterisk, closing logo and caption. Spring values estimated.
